title: Inventory report crashes when a SKU has no price
description: report.total_value() raises TypeError when an item has price None (unpriced items). Unpriced items should be skipped in the total and listed by unpriced_skus(). See tests/test_report.py. Do not change the tests.
acceptance_criteria: total_value() ignores items whose price is None
unpriced_skus() returns the SKUs of items with price None, in input order
